description: The Copernicus Climate Data Store publishes ERA5-Land, an hourly land-surface reanalysis built by rerunning the land component of ERA5 at roughly 9 km native spacing and distributed on a 0.1-degree grid. The current provider page covers 1950 to the present, gives a DOI and permits subset requests in GRIB through its web form and API. Its page states CC BY terms and free registration for data extraction; the exact licence version was not established from the inspected text. Soil moisture, runoff, snow, temperature and related fields can force drainage, reservoir-inflow, agricultural-water and heat-exposure simulations. These are model-assimilated land estimates, not direct measurements at every grid cell. Terrain, irrigation and urban surfaces can differ from the gridded representation, and recent values may be revised. ERA5-Land is separate from data-era5-reanalysis, which covers the atmosphere at coarser grid spacing and different DOI. No grid was downloaded or run. A limitation is that grid-scale runoff and soil moisture may not represent managed drainage at a specific asset.
